frequency_question: How often do announced bilateral tariff threats proceed to actual implementation rather than being deferred, rescinded, or replaced by an agreement within 3 months?
membership_rule: Includes formal executive announcements of specific tariff rates on specific trading partners and goods; excludes vague legislative proposals or general rhetoric.
coverage_note: 5 major documented instances selected; broader set exists but these represent high-salience bilateral threats.
known_gaps: Does not exhaustively list minor antidumping/countervailing duty escalations.
skeleton: Major announced tariff threats post-Cold War
multiplier: 3 hits out of 5 named prominent cases equals 60 percent baseline execution rate.
validity_reason: Tied to current executive trade policy norms; expires with the current administration style.
